title: 17-yr-old killed over affair in TVM, 3 including girlfriend in custody
content: Thiruvananthapuram: The police have held three including two minors for allegedly murdering a 17-year-old boy at Pangappara in Thiruvannathapuram. The deceased has been identified as Abhiram, a native of Pangappara in Thiruvananthapuram. He was reportedly killed following a dispute over a love affair. His body was found inside a sack on Monday. According to police, the boy was strangled to death and his body was stuffed into a sack and abandoned in a plantain farm. The police are probing if the minors sought the help of a goon in committing the murder. Abhiram had been reported missing on Sunday afternoon, following which the Sreekaryam police registered a missing person case. During the investigation, the police recovered an Instagram chat from his mobile phone. The conversation revealed that a girl had asked him to meet her at a particular location. Abhiram reportedly believed that the message was from his girlfriend. However, the account had allegedly been created by one of his friends, who was also in love with the same girl. The friend had used the fake account to lure Abhiram to the location. He was accompanied by another mutual friend. An argument reportedly broke out between them and soon turned violent. According to the police, the friend asked Abhiram not to pursue the relationship with the girl. When Abhiram questioned what the friend would do if he continued the affair, the exchange escalated into a confrontation that allegedly ended in his murder. The police are yet to establish the exact manner in which Abhiram was killed and ascertain other details of the crime. The case, initially registered as a missing person complaint, will now be altered to include murder charges, police said. The police are also probing whether others were involved in the crime. Speaking to the media, a senior police officer confirmed that, apart from the two friends taken into custody, another person was also under observation as part of the investigation. The officer said the inquest proceedings were yet to be completed. The post-mortem examination and other procedures are scheduled to be conducted on Tuesday. Meanwhile, a large crowd gathered at the spot where the body was found. Some people alleged lapses on the part of the police in handling the case. However, the officer dismissed the allegations, saying that it was too early in the investigation to disclose further details. Two of the accused in custody are minors.
